name: codal-bench
description:
CODAL-Bench - Evaluating LLM Alignment to Coding Preferences
	

This benchmark comprises 500 random samples of CodeUltraFeedback dataset. 
The benchmark includes responses of multiple closed-source LLMs that can be used as references when judging other LLMs using LLM-as-a-Judge:

OpenAI - GPT-3.5-Turbo
OpenAI - GPT-4-Turbo
Anthropic - Claude-3-sonnet-20240229


	
		
	
	
		LLM Alignment Evaluation
	

Please refer to our GitHub repository to evaluate your own LLM on CODAL-Bench using… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/coseal/codal-bench.
reputation: Emerging benchmark for measuring LLM alignment to coding preferences; includes closed-source model responses as references and is used in alignment/LLM-as-judge workflows.
